verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public first-party GitHub repository (github.com/semgrep/semgrep) for the core engine, so its source appears readable. No item names an open-source license, and a community comment notes that Semgrep Supply Chain is not open source, so only part of the product is shown to be open. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented open license (e.g. LGPL/MIT) for the source, clarity on which components are open versus proprietary, and independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
